decisions.change: Prioritize the red-shoes return and order routes while labeling each route with its actual reached screen. Keep discovery informational and leave starting to the host; disclose incomplete coverage.
Keep the jacket informational and non-editable. Display live selected line IDs and flag source selections outside the red-shoes-only scope.

Offer supported reason and method choices, distinguish selected choices from observed method values, preserve original-payment intent, and expose the QR method's observed destination dependency with Restore controls.

Render deduction, expected refund and destination from runtime task data. Keep missing values explicitly unknown. Provide only Validate and Restore actions; leave exact approval, submission and independently verified completion to the host.

Use a warm cream canvas, forest text, restrained green accents, visible native-control labels, strong focus indicators, live status messaging and a responsive single-column layout instead of decorative product graphics.
